Thanks for the context. I reviewed Novocare_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx and the redline_summary. High-level traffic-light:
- Green: fee proration mechanism; the credit language and effective-date wording are fine.
- Amber: "Usage definitions" and "monitoring/overage" — suggest we add a short clause:
  • Redwood will provide thresholds/alerts for SKU usage and a 24-hour billing grace period; overage rates revert to Standard until the next billing cycle.
  • This protects Novocare from accidental spikes but preserves Redwood's billing model.
- Red: data residency paragraph where Novocare requested a specific on-prem carve — we cannot guarantee on-prem routing from the hosted pool. Need more detail from Novocare on what exactly they're requiring (per-tenant routing to VPC, or simply that PHI stays in region?).

Action items from Legal:
1) I've inserted inline comments in the redline (see attached SOC2_evidence_excerpt.pdf that they asked for; it's fine to attach to procurement).
2) Proposed fallback language for the data residency ask (insert after Section 4.2): "If Customer requires region-locking or dedicated VPC routing, parties will execute a Private Deployment Addendum and associated SOW."

Ava / Emily — if Novocare truly needs region-locking, that triggers Private deployment pricing and a longer lead time. Please confirm via reply if this is a hard requirement.
